blocks.text: PIANO REMOVAL FAQ
Piano Removal in Pickering— What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does piano removal cost in Pickering?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough — an upright or console costs less than a full grand piano, whatever decade either one is from.

items.q: Our family piano hasn't been played in twenty years — is that a problem?
a: Not for us. Pianos that have sat unused for decades often have tired hardware and finish wear, and we handle that as routine — the same careful process as a newer piano, just with a bit more caution around what’s underneath.

items.q: Do you charge extra for stairs?
a: No. Narrow staircases and multi-floor moves are factored into one flat quote at the walkthrough.

items.q: What's involved in moving a grand or baby grand piano?
a: Legs, the lid and sometimes the pedal lyre come off to fit through doorways and stairwells, and the piano moves on proper piano boards.

items.q: Can you clear a piano ahead of an addition being built?
a: Yes — removal times to land before your contractor’s foundation work begins, cleared exactly to fit the plan.
